findings.excerpt: Several of Howmet’s largest customers have captive superalloy furnaces for producing airfoil investment castings for their own use.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：新進入者可能與 Howmet 產品競爭或取代之；產業整併可能使客戶改用對手
findings.excerpt: New entrants in our markets, new product offerings, new and/or emerging technologies in the marketplace, or new facilities may compete with or replace Howmet products.

findings.claim: TIKR 報導：GE Aerospace 同意以 117.5 億美元收購鑄件對手 Consolidated Precision Products，預計 2027 下半年完成（二手來源，未見一手公告）
findings.source: TIKR blog：Howmet Aerospace stock dropped nearly 11% after GE bought a rival casting supplier
findings.excerpt: GE Aerospace agreed to buy Consolidated Precision Products, a rival casting maker, for $11.75 billion
